[[File:Gregory Reid 1999 Worlds finalist.gif|thumb|right|260px|Gregory Reid, 1999 Worlds finalist. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Gregory Reid''' finished 8th at the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], the Bespin Regional qualifier from Coralville, Iowa.<ref name="sw03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20001219103500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW03_1.html Day 2 scores SW.03], Decipher (Wayback 19 December 2000)</ref><ref name="field">[https://web.archive.org/web/19991128125001/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/finalists.html Finalists], Decipher (Wayback 28 November 1999)</ref>
